analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is now consolidating in the neutral zone at 42.7. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX is at 20.4, indicating an early stage of trend formation, warranting a pause in directional judgment. The 5-day high pattern shows a downtrend, and the price is below the resistance at $1.29. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.81x the 5-day average, requiring confirmation of direction.
